geometry.nativeRadiusPolicy: explicit proposal-only radius; unchanged full rectangle must validate every candidate

candidateRanking.ordering: descending conservative centre clearance; original common-frame horizontal task-goal distance; source i,j
candidateRanking.heightZeroMeaning: steering centres lie on the supplied model plane, not measured body poses

arrivalScoring: Future actor must use original task goal and unchanged task-arrival rule, never a second 0.35 m tolerance around steering
failureScope: At most first 32 ranked existing centres within the unchanged task region; not proof that all region goals are unreachable
